data.name: Farrokhzad
data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, Farrokhzad means 'Lady of good fortune'. This name is derived from the Persian words 'farrokh' meaning 'fortune' or 'prosperity' and 'zad' meaning 'giver'. in_pashto.name: فرخزاد
